summary: The PR addresses an inconsistency in the behavior of the `mincnt` parameter in `hexbin` when the `C` parameter is provided. The proposed change aligns the behavior with the case where `C` is not provided.

issues.description: This change may introduce a behavioral regression risk as it alters the existing behavior of `hexbin` when `C` is provided. Existing users relying on the current behavior might experience unexpected results.
While the automated tests pass, there are no specific tests added to verify the new behavior introduced by this change. Additional tests should be included to ensure the fix is robust.
The PR does not include any documentation updates to reflect the change in behavior. Updating the relevant documentation would improve clarity for users.
